question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4.
solution: The correct answer is **"encourage."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The word **"encourage"** means to give support, confidence, or hope to someone. It is a verb. ((किसी को) प्रोत्‍साहित करना; (किसी की) हिम्‍मत बढ़ाना) • **Example**: *The teacher **encouraged**__ her students to ask questions.* • In the given sentence, the most appropriate option to fill in blank 4 is** "encourage"** because it fits the context and makes the sentence meaningful. • The other options do not fit the context of the sentence or make it grammatically incorrect. • The correct answer is option 3. • Correct passage: I know these authors to __be__ outstanding individuals and remarkable teachers and consultants and have even __seen__ them work their magic in training seminars, but I didn’t know if they __could__ take this complex topic and fit into a book.
